explication: GeoNode is a Django-based geospatial content-management platform for publishing datasets and documents, editing metadata, and creating interactive maps. A typical user submits geospatial content through upload APIs; format-specific handlers and resource managers create resources, store files, and synchronize datasets with GeoServer. Users then manage metadata and sharing and discover or visualize published content through search, catalogue, map, and API features. The README documents these product capabilities; sampled managers establish some internal calls, while unsampled wiring is left out.
